fusions.name: Pull to the Anvil
fusions.desc: Hauls the target down onto a crushing blow that deals 32 blunt damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattening Drag
fusions.desc: Drags an enemy up to 5 tiles away off its feet with a strike that deals 12 blunt damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nailed Down
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 2.5 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ringing Strike
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
